verdict.rationale: Greptile documents dashboard-level review settings that per-repo `greptile.json` files override (docs-22). It also documents review controls such as strictness, filters and triggers (docs-20, docs-46) and directory-scoped team settings (docs-48), which together suggest a defaults-plus-overrides model. However, exceptions live in per-repo files rather than being managed centrally, and nothing shows the dashboard defaults applying org-wide across hundreds of repos. missing for 10: explicit org-wide default review policy documentation, central exception management (rather than per-repo greptile.json overrides), evidence of rollout at hundreds-of-repos scale, independent corroboration.
